response.sql: WITH rating_stats AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_per_day_rate FROM film GROUP BY rating), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_per_day_rate) AS cross_rating_avg FROM rating_stats) SELECT r.rating, r.avg_replacement_cost, r.avg_per_day_rate, r.avg_per_day_rate - b.cross_rating_avg AS amount_above_cross_rating_avg FROM rating_stats r CROSS JOIN benchmark b WHERE r.avg_per_day_rate > b.cross_rating_avg ORDER BY r.rating

assumptions.assumption: The average per-day rate is the average of each film's rental rate divided by its rental duration.
